fold traigent-first-run's field-tested lessons into the front door: new 'Inspect what is already there before Step 1' entry (read existing run records such as traigent-runs/ or save_to= files, name the target before quoting a number, substitutes stay substitutes, never re-run a paid phase to move a number, setup-audit first for a project with no run); Step 3.6 real probe is paid so it is priced on the Step 4 card and launched only after the Step 5 go, never before; the real-run snippet no longer sets TRAIGENT_COST_APPROVED as a gate (verified on 0.27.0: check_and_approve admits any estimate under the limit with no prompt; the variable only skips the SDK's over-limit and unpriced-model refusals) and reads stop_reason=='cost_limit' as a partial result plus best_config_margin['verdict'] (0.26.0+) so a statistical_tie is a no-boost result; Step 3.5 sanity gate runs only for a scorer read and classified deterministic (judge = paid, executing = disclosed); LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP set beside TRAIGENT_OFFLINE_MODE in the mock block and Step 8 (offline mode alone does not stop LiteLLM's import-time pricing fetch, first-run #132); Step 9 states the SDK handshake is conditional and the approval card is the gate. References: instrument-recipe.md dataset-path containment applies to every run, offline included (verified: no offline exemption in evaluators/base.py) and sets the LiteLLM flag; insights-and-iteration.md reads example scores and dataset quality first and triggers compute_scores only on explicit approval, citing the 2026-09-13 HTTP 500 witness recorded in traigent-setup-audit.
